5:       "id": "S001",
6:       "text": "H001 gives λ≥0, so n=λ+1>0 and I consists of exactly n integers. We prove the string identities simultaneously by natural induction on t≥0. At t=0, hv=λv and xv=0 are H003. In the induction step temporarily assume L1: h y^t v=(λ−2t)y^t v and, when t≥1, x y^t v=t(λ−t+1)y^(t−1)v (with xv=0 at t=0). The relation hy=yh−2y from H002 gives h y^(t+1)v=(λ−2t−2)y^(t+1)v. The relation xy=yx+h gives x y^(t+1)v=y(x y^t v)+h y^t v=[t(λ−t+1)+λ−2t]y^t v=(t+1)(λ−t)y^t v, also at t=0 using xv=0. This proves the step and discharges L1; natural induction gives both identities for all t in their stated ranges."
7:     },
8:     {
9:       "id": "S002",
10:       "text": "For each i∈I, repeated application of the x identity in F001 gives x^i y^i v=i!λ(λ−1)⋯(λ−i+1)v. At i=0 the product is empty and equals 1; at i≥1 its factors are positive integers, since i≤λ. Since v≠0 by H003, this shows e_i≠0 over ℂ. F001 gives h e_i=(λ−2i)e_i. To prove independence, fix coefficients c and temporarily assume L2: Σ_(i∈I)c_i e_i=0. Fix j∈I and apply ∏_(k∈I,k≠j)(h−(λ−2k)Id_V). Every term except j is zero; the j term is c_j [∏_(k≠j)2(k−j)]e_j. All its factors are nonzero complex numbers and e_j≠0, so c_j=0. Since j was arbitrary, all coefficients vanish. Discharging L2 proves independence."
11:     },
12:     {
13:       "id": "S003",
14:       "text": "Apply M001 to the division ring ℂ, the complex vector space V, the finite index set I and the family e. F002 supplies independence, F001 gives |I|=n, and H002 gives dim_ℂ V=λ+1=n and finite dimensionality. Thus the span of e is V, so together with independence it is a basis. By F001, y^(λ+1)v has eigenvalue −λ−2 under h. Expand this vector in the basis e; comparison of each coefficient in h y^(λ+1)v=(−λ−2)y^(λ+1)v gives [λ−2i−(−λ−2)] times that coefficient zero. For i∈I this multiplier is 2(λ+1−i)≠0 in ℂ. Every coefficient is zero, hence y^(λ+1)v=0. Applying further powers of y gives all higher vanishing."

16:     {
17:       "id": "S004",
18:       "text": "For arbitrary i∈I divide the identities F001 by i!: x e_0=0, and for i≥1, x e_i=(λ−i+1)e_(i−1). Directly y e_i=(i+1)e_(i+1) for i<λ, while y e_λ=0 by F003. Also h e_i=(λ−2i)e_i. These are the required integer action matrices."

20:     {
21:       "id": "S005",
22:       "text": "Fix r≥0. Iterating the x matrix in F004 and dividing by r! gives X(r)e_i=[(λ−i+1)⋯(λ−i+r)/r!]e_(i−r)=binom(λ−i+r,r)e_(i−r) when r≤i. When r>i, iteration reaches x e_0=0 and gives zero. Similarly iteration of y gives Y(r)e_i=[(i+1)⋯(i+r)/r!]e_(i+r)=binom(i+r,r)e_(i+r) if i+r≤λ, and gives zero past the terminating string. These binomial coefficients have nonnegative top at least r. They are integers: for every nonnegative integer a₀, the factorial expressions have boundary values binom(a₀,0)=binom(a₀,a₀)=1 and satisfy binom(a₀,s)=binom(a₀−1,s−1)+binom(a₀−1,s) for 0<s<a₀ by a common-denominator calculation. Induction on a₀, proving the assertion simultaneously for all 0≤s≤a₀, proves integrality. This establishes every divided-power formula in the exported conclusion as well as its zero cases."

25:       "id": "S006",
26:       "text": "Since p is prime by H001, p≥2 and the integers not divisible by p are multiplicatively closed. Fraction addition and multiplication therefore make R a subring of ℚ⊂ℂ; in particular every integer b with p∤b is a unit, with inverse 1/b∈R. By H004 choose a simultaneous integer basis B of M and complex basis B of V. It has finitely many vectors since V has finite dimension n by H002. M010 applied to the nontrivial commutative ring ℂ supplies its strong rank condition. M003 applied to its complex basis gives that its number of vectors is dim_ℂ V=n. By N001, |I|=n; reindexing the basis by I yields the existence stated in F001."
27:     },
28:     {
29:       "id": "S007",
30:       "text": "Choose m as in F001. Apply M002 with R₀=ℤ, A=M, S₀=R and the integer basis m. It gives the R-basis (1⊗m_i)_(i∈I) of M_R. The map ι_M sends these basis vectors to m_i; a finite R-linear relation among their images is also a complex-linear relation, so all coefficients are zero. Thus ι_M is injective, identifies M_R with the R-span of the m_i inside V, and its complex span is V. For any r≥0, admissibility H004 and D005 imply X(r)M⊂M and Y(r)M⊂M; R-linearity gives preservation of M_R. In particular X(1)=x and Y(1)=y preserve M; H002 gives h=xy−yx on V, so h preserves M as well. The commutators in H002 show directly that the integer span of x,y,h is bracket-closed, since all three structure constants are integers. For arbitrary t₀∈ℤx+ℤy+ℤh and z_M∈M the restriction t₀z_M is in M. The rule (t₀⊗c₀)(z_M⊗d₀)=t₀z_M⊗(c₀d₀), for arbitrary c₀,d₀∈K, respects addition and both integer balancing relations, hence defines a K-bilinear action on the two tensor products. Its Lie representation identity is verified on pure tensors by the identity in the given complex Lie module V, and then on finite sums by bilinearity. Thus it is the asserted induced Lie action, without identifying the Chevalley integer form with any different reduction."

Their ratio binom(λ,j)=λ!/[j!(λ−j)!] is a unit of R, with inverse j!(λ−j)!/λ!. The factorials are positive and therefore nonzero as rational numbers. These statements also cover r=0."

37:       "id": "S009",
38:       "text": "We now identify operators by their actions on the complex basis e from N001. In Y(λ)X(λ), every basis vector below e_λ is killed by X(λ); on e_λ, X(λ)e_λ=e_0 and Y(λ)e_0=e_λ. Hence Π=E_λλ. Next X(λ−i)e_λ=e_i, with coefficient binom(λ−λ+λ−i,λ−i)=1, giving X(λ−i)Π=E_iλ. For ΠY(λ−j), an input e_k with k<j is carried below e_λ and killed by Π; if k>j the lowering string terminates and gives zero; on e_j its coefficient is binom(λ,λ−j)=binom(λ,j) and its image is e_λ. Therefore ΠY(λ−j)=binom(λ,j)E_λj. All statements include λ=0, when every factor is the identity on the one-dimensional space."

45:       "id": "S011",
46:       "text": "Use the embedding from N002 throughout to regard M_R as a submodule of V. By N001 its vectors have unique coordinates in e. Since E_ii preserves M_R by N002, the ith coordinate projection maps M_R onto J_i e_i. For arbitrary i,j₁∈I and c₁∈J_(j₁), E(i,j₁)(c₁ e_(j₁))=c₁ e_i∈M_R, giving J_(j₁)⊂J_i; the reverse inclusion follows by exchanging the two coordinate indices. Thus all J_i equal J. Choose the R-basis m of M_R supplied by N002. The finitely many ith coordinates of m generate J_i, since each vector of M_R is a finite R-linear combination of m, and conversely these coordinates lie in J_i by E_ii-stability. Hence J is finitely generated. It is nonzero: temporarily assume L1: J={0}. Then every coordinate projection of M_R would vanish, so M_R would be zero, contradicting its complex span V and the nonzero basis vector e_0 in N001. This contradiction discharges L1 and proves J≠{0}. Finally the maps M_R→J^I taking coordinates, and (c_i)↦Σ c_i e_i, are mutually inverse R-linear maps. The latter sum is in M_R since each c_i e_i is; independence in N001 gives uniqueness. This proves the direct sum decomposition without any rank assumption on a submodule of ℂ."

Apply M008 with F=ℚ and A=U to this finite set; since the span is all of U, U is finite-dimensional. To check injectivity of μ, let s₀≥0 be arbitrary, take arbitrary families Q_1,...,Q_(s₀)∈ℚ and C_1,...,C_(s₀)∈J, and set z₀=Σ_(l=1)^(s₀)Q_l⊗C_l. Every element of the algebraic tensor product has such a finite-sum presentation. Define D to be the product of the positive denominators of the Q_l (the empty product is 1), and put H_l=D Q_l∈ℤ. Then D is a nonzero integer and tensor balancing over R, which contains ℤ, gives z₀=(1/D)⊗Σ H_l C_l. Temporarily assume L2: μ(z₀)=0. Its image is (1/D)Σ H_l C_l, so Σ H_l C_l=0 in ℂ, hence z₀=0 in U. Discharge L2. Since the finite presentation was arbitrary, the kernel of μ is zero, which proves injectivity by applying this to the difference of any two tensors with equal images. Its image is exactly span_ℚ J, since it consists of finite rational combinations of elements of J and contains them all."

74:       "text": "By H001, an integer maps to zero in K exactly when divisible by p. The induced map R/pR→F_p is therefore a bijective ring map. Both constructions agree with the usual inclusion F_p→K. Every unit of R has nonzero image in K, since its image has a multiplicative inverse. In particular N002 shows that r! for 0≤r≤λ and binom(λ,j), j∈I, have nonzero images in K."

1: # Irreducibility after reduction of an admissible sl2 lattice
2: 
3: ## Original exercise
4: 
5: James E. Humphreys, *Introduction to Lie Algebras and Representation Theory*,
6: Graduate Texts in Mathematics 9, Springer, section 27, exercise 7,
7: printed page 164. The exercise-list convention on page 163 sets
8: \(L=\mathfrak{sl}_2\) and identifies weights with integers.
9: Book DOI: [10.1007/978-1-4612-6398-2](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4612-6398-2).
10: 
11: > 7. If \(0\leq\lambda<\operatorname{char}K\), \(V=V(\lambda)\),
12: > prove that \(V(K)\) is irreducible as \(L(K)\)-module.
13: 
14: ## Definitions and complete target
15: 
16: Let \(p\) be any prime, \(K\) any field of characteristic \(p\), and
17: \(\lambda\) an integer with \(0\leq\lambda<p\).
18: Let \(V(\lambda)\) be the complex irreducible highest-weight
19: \(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\)-module of highest weight \(\lambda\),
20: of dimension \(\lambda+1\). Its Chevalley generators satisfy
21: 
22: \[
23: [h,x]=2x,\qquad[h,y]=-2y,\qquad[x,y]=h.
24: \]
25: 
26: Choose a nonzero highest-weight vector \(v\) with \(xv=0\) and
27: \(hv=\lambda v\). Let \(U_{\mathbb Z}\) be the integer subalgebra of
28: the universal enveloping algebra generated by all divided powers
29: \(X_r=x^r/r!\), \(Y_r=y^r/r!\), for integers \(r\geq0\).
30: An **admissible lattice** \(M\subset V(\lambda)\) is a free abelian
31: subgroup with an integer basis that is also a complex basis, stable under
32: \(U_{\mathbb Z}\). It is arbitrary, not necessarily the minimal lattice.
33: 
34: Put \(V(K)=M\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\). The Lie algebra
35: \(L(K)=(\mathbb Zx+\mathbb Zy+\mathbb Zh)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\)
36: acts by the induced lattice operators. This is the Chevalley
37: \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) construction also in characteristic 2.
38: Prove that \(V(K)\) is nonzero and every \(K\)-linear subspace
39: invariant under \(x,y,h\) is zero or all of \(V(K)\).
40: Both \(\lambda=0\) and \(p=2\) are included; \(K\) need not be
41: algebraically closed.
42: 
43: ## Fixed natural-language proof
44: 
45: ### 1. Divided-power coordinates in characteristic zero
46: 
47: Put \(n=\lambda+1\) and \(e_i=y^iv/i!\) for \(0\leq i\leq\lambda\).
48: The commutator identities give, by induction,
49: 
50: \[
51: hy^iv=(\lambda-2i)y^iv,\qquad
52: xy^iv=i(\lambda-i+1)y^{i-1}v\quad(i\geq1).
53: \]
54: 
55: For \(i\leq\lambda\), applying \(x^i\) to \(y^iv\) gives
56: \(i!\lambda(\lambda-1)\cdots(\lambda-i+1)v\ne0\) over \(\mathbb C\).
57: At \(i=0\) the empty product is one. Thus every \(e_i\ne0\).
58: Their \(h\)-eigenvalues \(\lambda-2i\) are distinct over \(\mathbb C\),
59: so they are linearly independent: applying
60: \(\prod_{k\ne j}(h-(\lambda-2k)\mathrm{Id})\) to a relation isolates
61: its \(j\)-th coefficient with a nonzero multiplier.
62: There are \(n\) vectors, the dimension of \(V(\lambda)\), hence they
63: form a basis. Also \(y^{\lambda+1}v=0\), since otherwise it would be
64: an eigenvector of eigenvalue \(-\lambda-2\), absent from this basis.
65: All higher lowering powers vanish as well.
66: 
67: The operator matrices are therefore
68: 
69: \[
70: xe_0=0,\quad xe_i=(\lambda-i+1)e_{i-1}\ (i\geq1),\qquad
71: ye_i=(i+1)e_{i+1}\ (i<\lambda),\quad ye_\lambda=0,
72: \quad he_i=(\lambda-2i)e_i.
73: \]
74: 
75: Iteration gives the integral divided-power matrices
76: 
77: \[
78: X_re_i=\binom{\lambda-i+r}{r}e_{i-r}\quad(0\leq r\leq i),
79: \qquad
80: Y_re_i=\binom{i+r}{r}e_{i+r}\quad(i+r\leq\lambda).       \tag{1}
81: \]
82: 
83: The respective expressions are zero when \(r>i\) or
84: \(i+r>\lambda\), by termination of the strings just proved.
85: 
86: ### 2. Matrix units preserve the localized arbitrary lattice
87: 
88: Let \(R=\mathbb Z_{(p)}=\{a/b\in\mathbb Q:p\nmid b\}\), and regard
89: \(M_R=R\otimes_{\mathbb Z}M\) as a submodule of \(V(\lambda)\).
90: The embedding is injective because an integer basis of \(M\) is
91: complex-linearly independent. The module \(M_R\) is free of rank \(n\)
92: over \(R\) and is preserved by all \(X_r,Y_r\), by admissibility.
93: 
94: Define \(E_{ij}\) to send \(e_j\) to \(e_i\) and all other basis
95: vectors to zero. Formula (1) gives
96: 
97: \[
98: P:=Y_\lambda X_\lambda=E_{\lambda\lambda},\qquad
99: X_{\lambda-i}P=E_{i\lambda},\qquad
100: P Y_{\lambda-j}=\binom\lambda j E_{\lambda j}.
101: \]
102: 
103: For the last identity, an input index below \(j\) is sent below
104: \(e_\lambda\) and killed by \(P\); an index above \(j\) is sent past
105: the end of the lowering string. On \(e_j\) the coefficient is precisely
106: \(\binom\lambda j\). Since \(\lambda<p\), none of
107: \(\lambda!\), \(j!\), \((\lambda-j)!\) is divisible by \(p\), so
108: \(\binom\lambda j\) is a unit in \(R\). Consequently
109: 
110: \[
111: E_{ij}=\left(\binom\lambda j\right)^{-1}
112:        X_{\lambda-i}P Y_{\lambda-j}.                 \tag{2}
113: \]
114: 
115: Every matrix unit preserves \(M_R\). No assertion about distinct
116: weights modulo \(p\) has been used.
117: 
118: ### 3. Recover a standard basis for the arbitrary lattice
119: 
120: Define \(J_i=\{c\in\mathbb C:c e_i\in M_R\}\).
121: The coordinate projection \(E_{ii}\) maps \(M_R\) onto \(J_i e_i\).
122: Applying \(E_{ij}\) to \(c e_j\) shows \(J_j\subseteq J_i\);
123: reversing the indices gives equality. Let \(J\) be their common module.
124: It is finitely generated, being a projection of a finite free module,
125: and nonzero because \(M_R\) spans \(V(\lambda)\) over \(\mathbb C\).
126: The coordinate projections and independence of the \(e_i\) give
127: 
128: \[
129: M_R=\bigoplus_{i=0}^{\lambda}J e_i.                  \tag{3}
130: \]
131: 
132: One must still prove that \(J\) has rank one; containment in
133: \(\mathbb C\) alone does not imply that. Let
134: \(r=\dim_{\mathbb Q}(\mathbb Q\otimes_R J)\), which is finite.
135: Tensoring (3) with the fraction field \(\mathbb Q\) and using the
136: rank \(n\) of \(M_R\) gives \(n=nr\), so \(r=1\), since \(n>0\).
137: The multiplication map \(\mathbb Q\otimes_R J\to\mathbb C\) is
138: injective: this tensor product is the localization of the torsion-free
139: module \(J\subset\mathbb C\), and a fraction mapping to zero has
140: zero numerator. Thus \(J\) spans a one-dimensional rational line.
141: 
142: Choose \(0\ne a\in J\) and write a finite set of nonzero generators
143: as \(q_1a,\ldots,q_ka\) with \(q_j\in\mathbb Q^\times\).
144: Each \(q_j=p^{\nu_j}u_j\) for \(\nu_j\in\mathbb Z\) and a unit
145: \(u_j\) of \(R\). Let \(\nu=\min_j\nu_j\). All generators belong
146: to \(p^\nu R a\), and a generator with minimal exponent generates
147: that whole module. Therefore \(J=Rb\) for a nonzero \(b\in J\).
148: By (3), \(b e_0,\ldots,b e_\lambda\) is an \(R\)-basis of \(M_R\).
149: 
150: ### 4. Reduce and extend scalars
151: 
152: All denominators in \(R\) are invertible in \(K\), so the integer map
153: extends to \(R\to K\). The natural tensor maps give
154: 
155: \[
156: M\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\cong M_R\otimes_R K
157: \cong(M_R/pM_R)\otimes_{\mathbb F_p}K.
158: \]
159: 
160: For example the first map sends \(m\otimes c\) to
161: \((1\otimes m)\otimes c\); its inverse sends
162: \((r\otimes m)\otimes c\) to \(m\otimes\bar r c\).
163: The reduced images \(b_0,\ldots,b_\lambda\) of \(b e_i\) form a
164: \(K\)-basis, with exactly the matrices of step 1 reduced into \(K\).
165: The matrix-unit identities (2) persist on this basis.
166: 
167: For \(0\leq r\leq\lambda<p\), \(r!\ne0\) in \(K\), and the induced
168: \(X_r,Y_r\) equal \((r!)^{-1}x^r,(r!)^{-1}y^r\). Hence any
169: \(K\)-subspace invariant under \(x,y\) is invariant under every matrix
170: unit in (2).
171: 
172: ### 5. Conclude irreducibility
173: 
174: Let \(W\) be invariant. If it is nonzero, choose
175: \(0\ne w=\sum_i c_i b_i\in W\), and an index \(j\) with \(c_j\ne0\).
176: For every \(i\), \(E_{ij}w=c_jb_i\in W\). Division by \(c_j\)
177: gives \(b_i\in W\), so all basis vectors lie in \(W\) and
178: \(W=V(K)\). Since \(\dim_K V(K)=\lambda+1>0\), it is nonzero and
179: irreducible. If \(\lambda=0\), all relevant factorials and binomial
180: coefficients are one and the argument applies unchanged. For \(p=2\),
181: the allowed \(\lambda\) are zero and one; the proof still works
182: without requiring distinct reduced \(h\)-eigenvalues.
183:

185:

187: arbitrary-lattice argument. It is not an NL0 artifact, an Audit A receipt,
188: a Lean proof, or a passing test result. Future runs must construct and check
189: those artifacts from these explicit inputs, registering any foundational
190: module or localization results used by their NL0.

12: /-!
13: # Quotienting out a free `ℤ`-module
14: 
15: If `G` is a rank `d` free `ℤ`-module, then `G/nG` is a finite group of cardinality `n ^ d`.
16: -/
17: 
18: @[expose] public section
19: 
20: open Finsupp Function Module
21: 
22: variable {G H M : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {n : ℕ}
23: 
24: variable (G n) in
25: /-- `ModN G n` denotes the quotient of `G` by multiples of `n` -/
26: abbrev ModN : Type _ := G ⧸ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)
27: 
28: namespace ModN
29: 
30: instance : Module (ZMod n) (ModN G n) := QuotientAddGroup.zmodModule (by simp)
31: 
32: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
33: /-- The universal property of `ModN G n` in terms of monoids: Monoid homomorphisms from `ModN G n`
34: are the same as monoid homomorphisms from `G` whose values are `n`-torsion. -/
35: protected def liftEquiv [AddMonoid M] : (ModN G n →+ M) ≃ {φ : G →+ M // ∀ g, n • φ g = 0} where
36:   toFun f := ⟨f.comp (QuotientAddGroup.mk' _), fun g ↦ by
37:     let Gn : AddSubgroup G := (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)).toAddSubgroup
38:     suffices n • g ∈ (QuotientAddGroup.mk' Gn).ker by
39:       simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, comp_apply, ← map_nsmul]
40:       change f (QuotientAddGroup.mk' Gn (n • g)) = 0 -- Can we avoid `change`?
41:       rw [this, map_zero]
42:     simp [QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk', Gn]⟩
43:   invFun φ := QuotientAddGroup.lift _ φ <| by rintro - ⟨g, rfl⟩; simpa using φ.property g
44:   left_inv f := by
45:     ext x
46:     induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on
47:     rfl -- Should `simp` suffice here?
48:   right_inv φ := by aesop
49: 
50: /-- The universal property of `ModN G n` in terms of `ZMod n`-modules: `ZMod n`-linear maps from
51: `ModN G n` are the same as monoid homomorphisms from `G` whose values are `n`-torsion. -/
52: protected def liftEquiv' [AddCommGroup H] [Module (ZMod n) H] :
53:     (ModN G n →ₗ[ZMod n] H) ≃ {φ : G →+ H // ∀ g, n • φ g = 0} :=
54:   (AddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMapEquiv n).symm.toEquiv.trans ModN.liftEquiv
55: 
56: variable (n) in
57: /-- The quotient map `G → G / nG`. -/
58: def mkQ : G →+ ModN G n := (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)).mkQ
59: 
60: variable [NeZero n]
61: 
62: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
63: /-- Given a free module `G` over `ℤ`, construct the corresponding basis
64: of `G / ⟨n⟩` over `ℤ / nℤ`. -/
65: noncomputable def basis {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι ℤ G) : Basis ι (ZMod n) (ModN G n) := by
66:   set ψ : G →+ G := zsmulAddGroupHom n
67:   set nG := LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)
68:   set H := G ⧸ nG
69:   set φ : G →ₗ[ℤ] H := nG.mkQ
70:   let mod : (ι →₀ ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (ι →₀ ZMod n) := mapRange.linearMap (Int.castAddHom _).toIntLinearMap
71:   let f : G →ₗ[ℤ] (ι →₀ ℤ) := b.repr
72:   have hker : nG ≤ LinearMap.ker (mod.comp f) := by
73:     rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
74:     ext b
75:     simp [mod, f]
76:   let g : H →ₗ[ℤ] (ι →₀ ZMod n) := nG.liftQ (mod.comp f) hker
77:   refine ⟨.ofBijective (g.toAddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMap n) ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
78:   · rw [AddMonoidHom.coe_toZModLinearMap, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, injective_iff_map_eq_zero,
79:       nG.mkQ_surjective.forall]
80:     intro x hx
81:     simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, g] at hx
82:     rw [Submodule.liftQ_apply] at hx
83:     replace hx : ∀ b, ↑n ∣ f x b := by
84:       simpa [mod, DFunLike.ext_iff, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] using! hx
85:     simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply]
86:     rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
87:     choose c hc using hx
88:     refine ⟨b.repr.symm ⟨(f x).support, c, by simp [hc, NeZero.ne]⟩, b.repr.injective ?_⟩
89:     simpa [DFunLike.ext_iff, eq_comm] using! hc
90:   · suffices mod ∘ b.repr = g ∘ nG.mkQ by
91:       exact (this ▸ (mapRange_surjective _ (map_zero _) ZMod.intCast_surjective).comp
92:         b.repr.surjective).of_comp
93:     ext x b
94:     simp [mod, g, f, H]
95: 
96: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
97: lemma basis_apply_eq_mkQ {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι ℤ G) (i : ι) : basis b i = mkQ n (b i) := by
98:   rw [Basis.apply_eq_iff]; simp [basis, mkQ]
99:

102: instance instModuleFinite : Module.Finite (ZMod n) (ModN G n) :=
103:   .of_basis <| basis <| Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ G
104: 
105: instance instFinite : Finite (ModN G n) := Module.finite_of_finite (ZMod n)
106: 
107: variable (G n)
108: @[simp] lemma natCard_eq : Nat.card (ModN G n) = n ^ Module.finrank ℤ G := by
109:   simp [Nat.card_congr (basis <| Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ G).repr.toEquiv,
110:     Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Module.finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex]
111: 
112: end ModN

25: abbrev AddCommMonoid.zmodModule [NeZero n] [AddCommMonoid M] (h : ∀ (x : M), n • x = 0) :
26:     Module (ZMod n) M := by
27:   have h_mod (c : ℕ) (x : M) : (c % n) • x = c • x := by
28:     suffices (c % n + c / n * n) • x = c • x by rwa [add_nsmul, mul_nsmul, h, add_zero] at this
29:     rw [Nat.mod_add_div']
30:   have := NeZero.ne n
31:   match n with
32:   | n + 1 => exact {
33:     smul := fun (c : Fin _) x ↦ c.val • x
34:     smul_zero := fun _ ↦ nsmul_zero _
35:     zero_smul := fun _ ↦ zero_nsmul _
36:     smul_add := fun _ _ _ ↦ nsmul_add _ _ _
37:     one_smul := fun _ ↦ (h_mod _ _).trans <| one_nsmul _
38:     add_smul := fun _ _ _ ↦ (h_mod _ _).trans <| add_nsmul _ _ _
39:     mul_smul := fun _ _ _ ↦ (h_mod _ _).trans <| mul_nsmul' _ _ _
40:   }

42: /-- The `ZMod n`-module structure on Abelian groups whose elements have order dividing `n`.
43: See note [reducible non-instances]. -/
44: abbrev AddCommGroup.zmodModule {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (h : ∀ (x : G), n • x = 0) :
45:     Module (ZMod n) G :=
46:   match n with
47:   | 0 => AddCommGroup.toIntModule G
48:   | _ + 1 => AddCommMonoid.zmodModule h

50: /-- The quotient of an abelian group by a subgroup containing all multiples of `n` is a
51: `n`-torsion group. -/
52: -- See note [reducible non-instances]
53: abbrev QuotientAddGroup.zmodModule {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {H : AddSubgroup G}
54:     (hH : ∀ x, n • x ∈ H) : Module (ZMod n) (G ⧸ H) :=
55:   AddCommGroup.zmodModule <| by simpa [QuotientAddGroup.forall_mk, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_nsmul]

63: theorem map_smul (f : F) (c : ZMod n) (x : M) : f (c • x) = c • f x := by
64:   rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_cast c]
65:   exact map_intCast_smul f _ _ (cast c) x

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace LR
abbrev L := LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl (Fin 2) ℂ
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b}
abbrev C (p : ℕ) := RestrictScalars (R p) ℚ ℂ
abbrev I (l : ℤ) := Fin (l.toNat + 1)
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
noncomputable def dp {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V := ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r

variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
noncomputable def eNat (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
def Stable {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (W : Submodule F A) (f : Module.End F A) : Prop := ∀ w ∈ W, f w ∈ W
def ComplexHyp (l : ℤ) (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  IsSl2Triple h x y ∧ Submodule.span ℂ ({x,y,h} : Set L) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ s t : L, rho ⁅s,t⁆ = rho s * rho t - rho t * rho s) ∧
  FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = l.toNat + 1 ∧
  Nontrivial V ∧
  (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, (∀ t : L, Stable W (rho t)) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ∧
  (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ rho x w = 0 ∧ rho h w = (l : ℂ) • w)
def Admissible (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y : L) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (ι : Type) (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ M) (bc : Module.Basis ι ℂ V), ∀ i, (b i : V) = bc i) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp (rho x) r m ∈ M ∧ dp (rho y) r m ∈ M)
def Strings (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, t ((d ^ r) v) = ((l : ℂ) - 2 * (r : ℂ)) • (d ^ r) v) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → a ((d ^ r) v) = ((r : ℂ) * ((l : ℂ) - (r : ℂ) + 1)) • (d ^ (r-1)) v)
def BasisString (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val) ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, l.toNat < r → (d ^ r) v = 0)
def Matrices {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End F A) (e : ℕ → A) : Prop :=
  a (e 0) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ l.toNat → a (e i) = ((l : F) - (i : F) + 1) • e (i-1)) ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i < l.toNat → d (e i) = ((i : F)+1) • e (i+1)) ∧
  d (e l.toNat) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat → t (e i) = ((l : F) - 2*(i : F)) • e i)
def DividedMatrices (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ r i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat →
    dp a r (eNat d v i) =
      (if r ≤ i then (Nat.choose (l.toNat-i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i-r) else 0) ∧
    dp d r (eNat d v i) =
      (if i+r ≤ l.toNat then (Nat.choose (i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i+r) else 0)
def N1 (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < l+1 ∧ Fintype.card (I l) = (l+1).toNat ∧ Strings l a d t v ∧
  BasisString l d v ∧ Matrices l a d t (eNat d v) ∧ DividedMatrices l a d v
noncomputable def unit (l : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) (i j : I l) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def BasisSpec (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val
def LocalRingSpec (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b) ∧
  (∀ b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → IsUnit (b : R p))
def SmallUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → ¬ p ∣ r.factorial ∧ IsUnit (r.factorial : R p)) ∧
  (∀ j : I l, IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : R p))
def IotaSpec (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : R p) (m : M), f (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ (r : R p) (z : MR p M), f (r • z) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • f z)
def LocalBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective f ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range f) = ⊤
def Preserved (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp a r m ∈ M ∧ dp d r m ∈ M) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ z : MR p M, dp a r (f z) ∈ Set.range f ∧ dp d r (f z) ∈ Set.range f)
def UnitIdentities (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat = unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) = unit l b i (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val) = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) j
def AllUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V)
    (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    unit l b i j = ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val)) ∧
    (∀ z : MR p M, unit l b i j (f z) ∈ Set.range f)
end LR

premise_types.H003: v ≠ 0 ∧ rho x v = 0 ∧ rho h v = (l : ℂ) • v

def Stable {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (W : Submodule F A) (f : Module.End F A) : Prop := ∀ w ∈ W, f w ∈ W
def ComplexHyp (l : ℤ) (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  IsSl2Triple h x y ∧ Submodule.span ℂ ({x,y,h} : Set L) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ s t : L, rho ⁅s,t⁆ = rho s * rho t - rho t * rho s) ∧
  FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = l.toNat + 1 ∧
  Nontrivial V ∧
  (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, (∀ t : L, Stable W (rho t)) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ∧
  (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ rho x w = 0 ∧ rho h w = (l : ℂ) • w)
def Admissible (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y : L) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (ι : Type) (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ M) (bc : Module.Basis ι ℂ V), ∀ i, (b i : V) = bc i) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp (rho x) r m ∈ M ∧ dp (rho y) r m ∈ M)
def Strings (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, t ((d ^ r) v) = ((l : ℂ) - 2 * (r : ℂ)) • (d ^ r) v) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → a ((d ^ r) v) = ((r : ℂ) * ((l : ℂ) - (r : ℂ) + 1)) • (d ^ (r-1)) v)
def BasisString (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val) ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, l.toNat < r → (d ^ r) v = 0)
def Matrices {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End F A) (e : ℕ → A) : Prop :=
  a (e 0) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ l.toNat → a (e i) = ((l : F) - (i : F) + 1) • e (i-1)) ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i < l.toNat → d (e i) = ((i : F)+1) • e (i+1)) ∧
  d (e l.toNat) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat → t (e i) = ((l : F) - 2*(i : F)) • e i)
def DividedMatrices (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ r i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat →
    dp a r (eNat d v i) =
      (if r ≤ i then (Nat.choose (l.toNat-i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i-r) else 0) ∧
    dp d r (eNat d v i) =
      (if i+r ≤ l.toNat then (Nat.choose (i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i+r) else 0)
def N1 (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < l+1 ∧ Fintype.card (I l) = (l+1).toNat ∧ Strings l a d t v ∧
  BasisString l d v ∧ Matrices l a d t (eNat d v) ∧ DividedMatrices l a d v
noncomputable def unit (l : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) (i j : I l) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def BasisSpec (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val
def LocalRingSpec (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b) ∧
  (∀ b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → IsUnit (b : R p))
def SmallUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → ¬ p ∣ r.factorial ∧ IsUnit (r.factorial : R p)) ∧
  (∀ j : I l, IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : R p))
def IotaSpec (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : R p) (m : M), f (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ (r : R p) (z : MR p M), f (r • z) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • f z)
def LocalBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=

  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range f) = ⊤
def Preserved (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=

  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ z : MR p M, dp a r (f z) ∈ Set.range f ∧ dp d r (f z) ∈ Set.range f)
def UnitIdentities (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat = unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧

    (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val) = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) j
def AllUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V)
    (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    unit l b i j = ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val)) ∧
    (∀ z : MR p M, unit l b i j (f z) ∈ Set.range f)

    unit l b i j = ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val)) ∧
    (∀ z : MR p M, unit l b i j (f z) ∈ Set.range f)

abbrev LZ (x y h : L) := Submodule.span ℤ ({x,y,h} : Set L)
def Lift (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) (g : Module.End K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  ∃ fm : Module.End ℤ M, (∀ m : M, (fm m : V) = f (m : V)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), g (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (fm m))
structure Action (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) where
  onM : LZ x y h →ₗ[ℤ] Module.End ℤ M
  onM_spec : ∀ s : LZ x y h, ∀ m : M, (onM s m : V) = rho (s : L) (m : V)
  bracket_mem : ∀ s t : LZ x y h, ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ ∈ LZ x y h
  red : K ⊗[ℤ] LZ x y h →ₗ[K] Module.End K (VK K M)
  red_spec : ∀ (c d : K) (s : LZ x y h) (m : M),
    red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] onM s m
  red_lie : ∀ s t u : LZ x y h, (u : L) = ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ → ∀ c d : K,
    red ((c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) = red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) * red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) - red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) * red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s)
  a : Module.End K (VK K M)
  d : Module.End K (VK K M)
  t : Module.End K (VK K M)
  a_spec : Lift K M (rho x) a
  d_spec : Lift K M (rho y) d
  t_spec : Lift K M (rho h) t
  gen_spec : ∀ (s : LZ x y h),
    ((s : L) = x → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = a) ∧
    ((s : L) = y → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = d) ∧
    ((s : L) = h → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = t)
def N2 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalRingSpec p ∧ SmallUnits p l ∧ Nonempty (Action K M rho x y h) ∧
  ∃ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f ∧ LocalBasis p l M f ∧
    Preserved p M f (rho x) (rho y) ∧
    (∀ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, BasisSpec l (rho y) v b →
      UnitIdentities l (rho x) (rho y) b ∧ AllUnits p l M f (rho x) (rho y) b)
def CoeffSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (i : I l) (c : ℂ), c ∈ J ↔ c • eNat d v i.val ∈ Set.range f) ∧
  J.FG ∧ J ≠ ⊥ ∧
  ∃ D : (I l → J) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M, ∀ g : I l → J, f (D g) = ∑ i, ((g i : C p) : ℂ) • eNat d v i.val
def MuSpec (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), mu (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * ((c : C p) : ℂ)
def RationalEmbedding (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) ∧
  ∃ mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ, MuSpec p J mu ∧ Function.Injective mu ∧
    LinearMap.range mu = Submodule.span ℚ (J : Set ℂ)
def ScaledBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M), ∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val
def CyclicSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {b}) ∧
  (∀ b : ℂ, b ∈ J → b ≠ 0 → J = Submodule.span (R p) {b} → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b)
def N3 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f →
    ∃ J : Submodule (R p) (C p), CoeffSpec p l d v M f J ∧ RationalEmbedding p J ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧ CyclicSpec p l d v M f J
def RationalMultiples (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : ℂ, a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, c ∈ J → ∃ q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
def PDecomposition (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 → ∃ (nu : ℤ) (u : (R p)ˣ), q = (p : ℚ)^nu * (u.val : ℚ)
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
  ∃ A : Action K M rho x y h, ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Stable W A.a → Stable W A.d → Stable W A.t → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
end LR
types: LR.N2 p l K M rho x y h v
LR.N3 p l (rho y) v M
LR.Target K M rho x y h

66: However, it is usually better just to add this extra structure as an argument:
67: ```lean
68: -- an `R`-module structure on `M` and proof of its compatibility is provided by the user
69: example [Module R M] [IsScalarTower R S M] : M →ₗ[R] S := sorry
70: ```
71: The advantage of the second approach is that it defers the duty of providing the missing typeclasses
72: `[Module R M] [IsScalarTower R S M]`. If some concrete `M` naturally carries these (as is often
73: the case) then we have avoided `RestrictScalars` entirely. If not, we can pass
74: `RestrictScalars R S M` later on instead of `M`.
75: 
76: Note that this means we almost always want to state definitions and lemmas in the language of
77: `IsScalarTower` rather than `RestrictScalars`.
78: 
79: An example of when one might want to use `RestrictScalars` would be if one has a vector space
80: over a field of characteristic zero and wishes to make use of the `ℚ`-algebra structure. -/
81: @[nolint unusedArguments]
82: def RestrictScalars (_R _S M : Type*) : Type _ := M
83: 
84: instance [I : Inhabited M] : Inhabited (RestrictScalars R S M) := I
85: 
86: instance [I : AddCommMonoid M] : AddCommMonoid (RestrictScalars R S M) := I
87: 
88: instance [I : AddCommGroup M] : AddCommGroup (RestrictScalars R S M) := I
89: 
90: section Module
91: 
92: section
93: 
94: variable [Semiring S] [AddCommMonoid M]
95: 
96: /-- We temporarily install an action of the original ring on `RestrictScalars R S M`. -/
97: @[instance_reducible]
98: def RestrictScalars.moduleOrig [I : Module S M] : Module S (RestrictScalars R S M) := I
99: 
100: variable [CommSemiring R] [Algebra R S]
101: 
102: section
103: 
104: attribute [local instance] RestrictScalars.moduleOrig
105: 
106: /-- When `M` is a module over a ring `S`, and `S` is an algebra over `R`, then `M` inherits a
107: module structure over `R`. Not an instance because `S` cannot be inferred.
108: 
109: The preferred way of setting this up is `[Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]`.
110: -/
111: abbrev Module.restrictScalars [Module S M] : Module R M :=
112:   Module.compHom M (algebraMap R S)
113: 
114: /-- When `M` is a module over a ring `S`, and `S` is an algebra over `R`, then `M` inherits a
115: module structure over `R`.
116: 
117: The preferred way of setting this up is `[Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]`.
118: -/
119: instance RestrictScalars.module [Module S M] : Module R (RestrictScalars R S M) :=
120:   Module.restrictScalars R S M
121: 
122: /-- `Module.restrictScalars` forms a scalar tower. -/
123: theorem IsScalarTower.restrictScalars [Module S M] :
124:     letI := Module.restrictScalars R S M
125:     IsScalarTower R S M :=
126:   IsScalarTower.of_compHom R S M
127: 
128: /-- This instance is only relevant when `RestrictScalars.moduleOrig` is available as an instance.
129: -/
130: instance RestrictScalars.isScalarTower [Module S M] : IsScalarTower R S (RestrictScalars R S M) :=
131:   IsScalarTower.restrictScalars R S M
132: 
133: end
134: 
135: /-- When `M` is a right-module over a ring `S`, and `S` is an algebra over `R`, then `M` inherits a
136: right-module structure over `R`.
137: The preferred way of setting this up is
138: `[Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [Module Sᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsScalarTower Rᵐᵒᵖ Sᵐᵒᵖ M]`.
139: -/
140: instance RestrictScalars.opModule [Module Sᵐᵒᵖ M] : Module Rᵐᵒᵖ (RestrictScalars R S M) :=
141:   letI : Module Sᵐᵒᵖ (RestrictScalars R S M) := ‹Module Sᵐᵒᵖ M›
142:   Module.compHom M (RingHom.op <| algebraMap R S)
143: 
144: instance RestrictScalars.isCentralScalar [Module S M] [Module Sᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsCentralScalar S M] :
145:     IsCentralScalar R (RestrictScalars R S M) where
146:   op_smul_eq_smul r _x := (op_smul_eq_smul (algebraMap R S r) (_ : M) :)
147: 
148: /-- The `R`-algebra homomorphism from the original coefficient algebra `S` to endomorphisms
149: of `RestrictScalars R S M`.
150: -/
151: def RestrictScalars.lsmul [Module S M] : S →ₐ[R] Module.End R (RestrictScalars R S M) :=
152:   -- We use `RestrictScalars.moduleOrig` in the implementation,
153:   -- but not in the type.
154:   letI : Module S (RestrictScalars R S M) := RestrictScalars.moduleOrig R S M
155:   Algebra.lsmul R R (RestrictScalars R S M)
156: 
157: end
158: 
159: variable [AddCommMonoid M]
160: 
161: /-- `RestrictScalars.addEquiv` is the additive equivalence with the original module. -/
162: def RestrictScalars.addEquiv : RestrictScalars R S M ≃+ M :=
163:   AddEquiv.refl M
164: 
165: variable [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] [Module S M]
166: 
167: theorem RestrictScalars.smul_def (c : R) (x : RestrictScalars R S M) :
168:     c • x = (RestrictScalars.addEquiv R S M).symm
169:       (algebraMap R S c • RestrictScalars.addEquiv R S M x) :=

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace LR
abbrev L := LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl (Fin 2) ℂ
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b}
abbrev C (p : ℕ) := RestrictScalars (R p) ℚ ℂ
def cv (p : ℕ) : C p ≃+ ℂ := RestrictScalars.addEquiv (R p) ℚ ℂ
abbrev I (l : ℤ) := Fin (l.toNat + 1)
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
noncomputable def dp {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V := ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r

variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
noncomputable def eNat (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
def Stable {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (W : Submodule F A) (f : Module.End F A) : Prop := ∀ w ∈ W, f w ∈ W
def ComplexHyp (l : ℤ) (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  IsSl2Triple h x y ∧ Submodule.span ℂ ({x,y,h} : Set L) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ s t : L, rho ⁅s,t⁆ = rho s * rho t - rho t * rho s) ∧
  FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = l.toNat + 1 ∧
  Nontrivial V ∧
  (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, (∀ t : L, Stable W (rho t)) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ∧
  (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ rho x w = 0 ∧ rho h w = (l : ℂ) • w)
def Admissible (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y : L) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (ι : Type) (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ M) (bc : Module.Basis ι ℂ V), ∀ i, (b i : V) = bc i) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp (rho x) r m ∈ M ∧ dp (rho y) r m ∈ M)
def Strings (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, t ((d ^ r) v) = ((l : ℂ) - 2 * (r : ℂ)) • (d ^ r) v) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → a ((d ^ r) v) = ((r : ℂ) * ((l : ℂ) - (r : ℂ) + 1)) • (d ^ (r-1)) v)
def BasisString (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val) ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, l.toNat < r → (d ^ r) v = 0)
def Matrices {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End F A) (e : ℕ → A) : Prop :=
  a (e 0) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ l.toNat → a (e i) = ((l : F) - (i : F) + 1) • e (i-1)) ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i < l.toNat → d (e i) = ((i : F)+1) • e (i+1)) ∧
  d (e l.toNat) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat → t (e i) = ((l : F) - 2*(i : F)) • e i)
def DividedMatrices (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ r i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat →
    dp a r (eNat d v i) =
      (if r ≤ i then (Nat.choose (l.toNat-i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i-r) else 0) ∧
    dp d r (eNat d v i) =
      (if i+r ≤ l.toNat then (Nat.choose (i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i+r) else 0)
def N1 (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < l+1 ∧ Fintype.card (I l) = (l+1).toNat ∧ Strings l a d t v ∧
  BasisString l d v ∧ Matrices l a d t (eNat d v) ∧ DividedMatrices l a d v
noncomputable def unit (l : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) (i j : I l) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def BasisSpec (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val
def LocalRingSpec (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b) ∧
  (∀ b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → IsUnit (b : R p))
def SmallUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → ¬ p ∣ r.factorial ∧ IsUnit (r.factorial : R p)) ∧
  (∀ j : I l, IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : R p))
def IotaSpec (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : R p) (m : M), f (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ (r : R p) (z : MR p M), f (r • z) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • f z)
def LocalBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective f ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range f) = ⊤
def Preserved (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp a r m ∈ M ∧ dp d r m ∈ M) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ z : MR p M, dp a r (f z) ∈ Set.range f ∧ dp d r (f z) ∈ Set.range f)
def UnitIdentities (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat = unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) = unit l b i (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val) = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) j
def AllUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V)
    (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    unit l b i j = ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val)) ∧
    (∀ z : MR p M, unit l b i j (f z) ∈ Set.range f)

abbrev LZ (x y h : L) := Submodule.span ℤ ({x,y,h} : Set L)
def Lift (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) (g : Module.End K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  ∃ fm : Module.End ℤ M, (∀ m : M, (fm m : V) = f (m : V)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), g (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (fm m))
structure Action (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) where
  onM : LZ x y h →ₗ[ℤ] Module.End ℤ M
  onM_spec : ∀ s : LZ x y h, ∀ m : M, (onM s m : V) = rho (s : L) (m : V)
  bracket_mem : ∀ s t : LZ x y h, ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ ∈ LZ x y h
  red : K ⊗[ℤ] LZ x y h →ₗ[K] Module.End K (VK K M)
  red_spec : ∀ (c d : K) (s : LZ x y h) (m : M),
    red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] onM s m
  red_lie : ∀ s t u : LZ x y h, (u : L) = ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ → ∀ c d : K,
    red ((c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) = red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) * red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) - red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) * red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s)
  a : Module.End K (VK K M)
  d : Module.End K (VK K M)
  t : Module.End K (VK K M)
  a_spec : Lift K M (rho x) a
  d_spec : Lift K M (rho y) d
  t_spec : Lift K M (rho h) t
  gen_spec : ∀ (s : LZ x y h),
    ((s : L) = x → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = a) ∧
    ((s : L) = y → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = d) ∧
    ((s : L) = h → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = t)
def N2 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalRingSpec p ∧ SmallUnits p l ∧ Nonempty (Action K M rho x y h) ∧
  ∃ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f ∧ LocalBasis p l M f ∧
    Preserved p M f (rho x) (rho y) ∧
    (∀ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, BasisSpec l (rho y) v b →
      UnitIdentities l (rho x) (rho y) b ∧ AllUnits p l M f (rho x) (rho y) b)
def CoeffSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (i : I l) (c : ℂ), (cv p).symm c ∈ J ↔ c • eNat d v i.val ∈ Set.range f) ∧
  J.FG ∧ J ≠ ⊥ ∧
  ∃ D : (I l → J) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M, ∀ g : I l → J, f (D g) = ∑ i, cv p (g i : C p) • eNat d v i.val
def MuSpec (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), mu (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * cv p (c : C p)
def RationalEmbedding (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) ∧
  ∃ mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ, MuSpec p J mu ∧ Function.Injective mu ∧
    LinearMap.range mu = Submodule.span ℚ ((cv p) '' (J : Set (C p)))
def ScaledBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M), ∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val
def CyclicSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b}) ∧
  (∀ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J → b ≠ 0 → J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b} → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b)
def N3 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f →
    ∃ J : Submodule (R p) (C p), CoeffSpec p l d v M f J ∧ RationalEmbedding p J ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧ CyclicSpec p l d v M f J
def RationalMultiples (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : ℂ, (cv p).symm a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, (cv p).symm c ∈ J → ∃ q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
def PDecomposition (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 → ∃ (nu : ℤ) (u : (R p)ˣ), q = (p : ℚ)^nu * (u.val : ℚ)
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
  ∃ A : Action K M rho x y h, ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Stable W A.a → Stable W A.d → Stable W A.t → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
end LR

30: /-- Linear endomorphisms of a module, with associated ring structure
31: `Module.End.semiring` and algebra structure `Module.End.algebra`. -/
32: abbrev Module.End (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] :=
33:   M →ₗ[R] M
34: 
35: variable {R R₂ S M M₁ M₂ M₃ N₁ : Type*}
36: 
37: open Function LinearMap
38: 
39: /-!
40: ## Monoid structure of endomorphisms
41: -/
42: 
43: namespace Module.End
44: 
45: variable [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommGroup N₁] [Module R M] [Module R N₁]
46: 
47: instance : One (Module.End R M) := ⟨LinearMap.id⟩
48: 
49: instance : Mul (Module.End R M) := ⟨fun f g => LinearMap.comp f g⟩
50: 
51: theorem one_eq_id : (1 : Module.End R M) = .id := rfl
52: 
53: theorem mul_eq_comp (f g : Module.End R M) : f * g = f.comp g := rfl
54: 
55: @[simp]
56: theorem one_apply (x : M) : (1 : Module.End R M) x = x := rfl
57: 
58: @[simp]
59: theorem mul_apply (f g : Module.End R M) (x : M) : (f * g) x = f (g x) := rfl
60: 
61: theorem coe_one : ⇑(1 : Module.End R M) = _root_.id := rfl
62: 
63: theorem coe_mul (f g : Module.End R M) : ⇑(f * g) = f ∘ g := rfl
64: 
65: instance instNontrivial [Nontrivial M] : Nontrivial (Module.End R M) := by
66:   obtain ⟨m, ne⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
67:   exact nontrivial_of_ne 1 0 fun p => ne (LinearMap.congr_fun p m)
68: 
69: instance instMonoid : Monoid (Module.End R M) where
70:   mul_assoc _ _ _ := LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
71:   mul_one := comp_id
72:   one_mul := id_comp
73: 
74: instance instSemiring : Semiring (Module.End R M) where
75:   __ := AddMonoidWithOne.unary
76:   __ := instMonoid
77:   __ := addCommMonoid
78:   mul_zero := comp_zero
79:   zero_mul := zero_comp
80:   left_distrib := fun _ _ _ ↦ comp_add _ _ _
81:   right_distrib := fun _ _ _ ↦ add_comp _ _ _
82:   natCast := fun n ↦ n • (1 : M →ₗ[R] M)
83:   natCast_zero := zero_smul ℕ (1 : M →ₗ[R] M)
84:   natCast_succ := fun n ↦ AddMonoid.nsmul_succ n (1 : M →ₗ[R] M)
85:

87: @[simp]
88: theorem natCast_apply (n : ℕ) (m : M) : (↑n : Module.End R M) m = n • m := rfl

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace LR
abbrev L := LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl (Fin 2) ℂ
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b}
abbrev C (p : ℕ) := RestrictScalars (R p) ℚ ℂ
def cv (p : ℕ) : C p ≃+ ℂ := RestrictScalars.addEquiv (R p) ℚ ℂ
abbrev I (l : ℤ) := Fin (l.toNat + 1)
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
noncomputable def dp {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V := ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r

variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
noncomputable def eNat (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
def Stable {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (W : Submodule F A) (f : Module.End F A) : Prop := ∀ w ∈ W, f w ∈ W
def ComplexHyp (l : ℤ) (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  IsSl2Triple h x y ∧ Submodule.span ℂ ({x,y,h} : Set L) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ s t : L, rho ⁅s,t⁆ = rho s * rho t - rho t * rho s) ∧
  FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = l.toNat + 1 ∧
  Nontrivial V ∧
  (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, (∀ t : L, Stable W (rho t)) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ∧
  (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ rho x w = 0 ∧ rho h w = (l : ℂ) • w)
def Admissible (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y : L) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (ι : Type) (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ M) (bc : Module.Basis ι ℂ V), ∀ i, (b i : V) = bc i) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp (rho x) r m ∈ M ∧ dp (rho y) r m ∈ M)
def Strings (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, t ((d ^ r) v) = ((l : ℂ) - 2 * (r : ℂ)) • (d ^ r) v) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → a ((d ^ r) v) = ((r : ℂ) * ((l : ℂ) - (r : ℂ) + 1)) • (d ^ (r-1)) v)
def BasisString (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val) ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, l.toNat < r → (d ^ r) v = 0)
def Matrices {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End F A) (e : ℕ → A) : Prop :=
  a (e 0) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ l.toNat → a (e i) = ((l : F) - (i : F) + 1) • e (i-1)) ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i < l.toNat → d (e i) = ((i : F)+1) • e (i+1)) ∧
  d (e l.toNat) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat → t (e i) = ((l : F) - 2*(i : F)) • e i)
def DividedMatrices (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ r i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat →
    dp a r (eNat d v i) =
      (if r ≤ i then (Nat.choose (l.toNat-i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i-r) else 0) ∧
    dp d r (eNat d v i) =
      (if i+r ≤ l.toNat then (Nat.choose (i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i+r) else 0)
def N1 (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < l+1 ∧ Fintype.card (I l) = (l+1).toNat ∧ Strings l a d t v ∧
  BasisString l d v ∧ Matrices l a d t (eNat d v) ∧ DividedMatrices l a d v
noncomputable def unit (l : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) (i j : I l) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def BasisSpec (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val
def LocalRingSpec (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b) ∧
  (∀ b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → IsUnit (b : R p))
def SmallUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → ¬ p ∣ r.factorial ∧ IsUnit (r.factorial : R p)) ∧
  (∀ j : I l, IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : R p))
def IotaSpec (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : R p) (m : M), f (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ (r : R p) (z : MR p M), f (r • z) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • f z)
def LocalBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective f ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range f) = ⊤
def Preserved (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp a r m ∈ M ∧ dp d r m ∈ M) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ z : MR p M, dp a r (f z) ∈ Set.range f ∧ dp d r (f z) ∈ Set.range f)
def UnitIdentities (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat = unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) = unit l b i (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val) = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) j
def AllUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V)
    (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    unit l b i j = ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val)) ∧
    (∀ z : MR p M, unit l b i j (f z) ∈ Set.range f)

abbrev LZ (x y h : L) := Submodule.span ℤ ({x,y,h} : Set L)
def Lift (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) (g : Module.End K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  ∃ fm : Module.End ℤ M, (∀ m : M, (fm m : V) = f (m : V)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), g (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (fm m))
structure Action (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) where
  onM : LZ x y h →ₗ[ℤ] Module.End ℤ M
  onM_spec : ∀ s : LZ x y h, ∀ m : M, (onM s m : V) = rho (s : L) (m : V)
  bracket_mem : ∀ s t : LZ x y h, ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ ∈ LZ x y h
  red : K ⊗[ℤ] LZ x y h →ₗ[K] Module.End K (VK K M)
  red_spec : ∀ (c d : K) (s : LZ x y h) (m : M),
    red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] onM s m
  red_lie : ∀ s t u : LZ x y h, (u : L) = ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ → ∀ c d : K,
    red ((c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) = red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) * red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) - red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) * red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s)
  a : Module.End K (VK K M)
  d : Module.End K (VK K M)
  t : Module.End K (VK K M)
  a_spec : Lift K M (rho x) a
  d_spec : Lift K M (rho y) d
  t_spec : Lift K M (rho h) t
  gen_spec : ∀ (s : LZ x y h),
    ((s : L) = x → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = a) ∧
    ((s : L) = y → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = d) ∧
    ((s : L) = h → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = t)
def N2 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalRingSpec p ∧ SmallUnits p l ∧ Nonempty (Action K M rho x y h) ∧
  ∃ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f ∧ LocalBasis p l M f ∧
    Preserved p M f (rho x) (rho y) ∧
    (∀ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, BasisSpec l (rho y) v b →
      UnitIdentities l (rho x) (rho y) b ∧ AllUnits p l M f (rho x) (rho y) b)
def CoeffSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (i : I l) (c : ℂ), (cv p).symm c ∈ J ↔ c • eNat d v i.val ∈ Set.range f) ∧
  J.FG ∧ J ≠ ⊥ ∧
  ∃ D : (I l → J) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M, ∀ g : I l → J, f (D g) = ∑ i, cv p (g i : C p) • eNat d v i.val
def MuSpec (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), mu (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * cv p (c : C p)
def RationalEmbedding (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) ∧
  ∃ mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ, MuSpec p J mu ∧ Function.Injective mu ∧
    LinearMap.range mu = Submodule.span ℚ ((cv p) '' (J : Set (C p)))
def ScaledBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M), ∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val
def CyclicSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b}) ∧
  (∀ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J → b ≠ 0 → J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b} → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b)
def N3 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f →
    ∃ J : Submodule (R p) (C p), CoeffSpec p l d v M f J ∧ RationalEmbedding p J ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧ CyclicSpec p l d v M f J
def RationalMultiples (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : ℂ, (cv p).symm a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, (cv p).symm c ∈ J → ∃ q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
def PDecomposition (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 → ∃ (nu : ℤ) (u : (R p)ˣ), q = (p : ℚ)^nu * (u.val : ℚ)
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
  ∃ A : Action K M rho x y h, ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Stable W A.a → Stable W A.d → Stable W A.t → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤

structure Residue (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] where
  phi : R p →+* K
  psi : R p →+* ZMod p
  kappa : ZMod p →+* K
  phi_fraction : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / b → phi r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹
  psi_fraction : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / b → psi r = (a : ZMod p) * (b : ZMod p)⁻¹
  kappa_int : ∀ a : ℤ, kappa (a : ZMod p) = (a : K)
  compatible : phi = kappa.comp psi
  psi_surjective : Function.Surjective psi
  psi_kernel : RingHom.ker psi = Ideal.span {(p : R p)}
  eps : (R p) ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : R p)} ≃+* ZMod p
  eps_spec : ∀ r : R p, eps (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(p : R p)}) r) = psi r
  units_nonzero : ∀ u : (R p)ˣ, phi u.val ≠ 0
def GammaPure (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra (R p) K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (phi : R p →+* K) (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M) : Prop :=
  (∀ (c : K) (m : M), G (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
  (∀ (c : K) (r : R p) (m : M), G.symm (c ⊗ₜ[R p] (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) = (phi r*c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
def DeltaPure (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra (R p) K] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (D : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), D (c ⊗ₜ[R p] z) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p z) ∧
  (∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), D.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p z) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] z)
def Bridge (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  letI := Q.kappa.toAlgebra
  ∃ (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
    (D : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)),
    GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧ DeltaPure p K M D ∧
    (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (z : VK K M),
      G (F.baseChange K z) = ((F.baseChange (R p)).baseChange K) (G z)) ∧
    (∀ F : Module.End (R p) (MR p M),
      ∃ Fb : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (MR p M) p),
        (∀ z : MR p M, Fb (ModN.mkQ p z) = ModN.mkQ p (F z)) ∧
        (∀ z : K ⊗[R p] MR p M, D (F.baseChange K z) = Fb.baseChange K (D z)))
def extend {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (l : ℤ)
    (b : Module.Basis (I l) F A) (k : ℕ) : A :=
  if hk : k < l.toNat+1 then b ⟨k,hk⟩ else 0
def polynomial {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End F A) (i j : I l) : Module.End F A :=
  (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : F)⁻¹ •
    (((((l.toNat-i.val).factorial : F)⁻¹) • a^(l.toNat-i.val)) *
    (((l.toNat.factorial : F)⁻¹) • d^l.toNat) *
    (((l.toNat.factorial : F)⁻¹) • a^l.toNat) *
    (((((l.toNat-j.val).factorial : F)⁻¹) • d^(l.toNat-j.val))))
def ReducedBasisSpec (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (A : Action K M rho x y h)
    (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat+1 ∧
  Matrices l A.a A.d A.t (extend l beta) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat →
    (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
    Lift K M (dp (rho x) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.a^r) ∧
    Lift K M (dp (rho y) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.d^r)) ∧
  (∀ i j : I l, (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ k : I l, polynomial l A.a A.d i j (beta k) = if k = j then beta i else 0)
def Transfer (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ), IotaSpec p M f → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b →
    ∃ (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
      (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
      GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧
      (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val) ∧
      (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) ∧
      Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat+1
def ReducedPackage (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ A : Action K M rho x y h,
    ∃ (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (b : ℂ)
      (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
      (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
      IotaSpec p M f ∧ Function.Injective f ∧ CoeffSpec p l (rho y) v M f J ∧
      (cv p).symm b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b} ∧
      GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧
      (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat (rho y) v i.val) ∧
      (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) ∧
      ReducedBasisSpec l K M rho x y h A beta
def N4 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ Q : Residue p K, Bridge p K M Q ∧ ReducedPackage p l K M rho x y h v Q
end LR

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace LR
abbrev L := LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl (Fin 2) ℂ
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := Subring.closure {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b}
abbrev C (p : ℕ) := RestrictScalars (R p) ℚ ℂ
def cv (p : ℕ) : C p ≃+ ℂ := RestrictScalars.addEquiv (R p) ℚ ℂ
abbrev I (l : ℤ) := Fin (l.toNat + 1)
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := (R p) ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
noncomputable def dp {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V := ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r

variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
noncomputable def eNat (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := dp y i v
def Stable {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (W : Submodule F A) (f : Module.End F A) : Prop := ∀ w ∈ W, f w ∈ W
def ComplexHyp (l : ℤ) (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  IsSl2Triple h x y ∧ Submodule.span ℂ ({x,y,h} : Set L) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ s t : L, rho ⁅s,t⁆ = rho s * rho t - rho t * rho s) ∧
  FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = l.toNat + 1 ∧
  Nontrivial V ∧
  (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, (∀ t : L, Stable W (rho t)) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) ∧
  (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ rho x w = 0 ∧ rho h w = (l : ℂ) • w)
def Admissible (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y : L) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (ι : Type) (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ M) (bc : Module.Basis ι ℂ V), ∀ i, (b i : V) = bc i) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp (rho x) r m ∈ M ∧ dp (rho y) r m ∈ M)
def Strings (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, t ((d ^ r) v) = ((l : ℂ) - 2 * (r : ℂ)) • (d ^ r) v) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → a ((d ^ r) v) = ((r : ℂ) * ((l : ℂ) - (r : ℂ) + 1)) • (d ^ (r-1)) v)
def BasisString (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val) ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, l.toNat < r → (d ^ r) v = 0)
def Matrices {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End F A) (e : ℕ → A) : Prop :=
  a (e 0) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ l.toNat → a (e i) = ((l : F) - (i : F) + 1) • e (i-1)) ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i < l.toNat → d (e i) = ((i : F)+1) • e (i+1)) ∧
  d (e l.toNat) = 0 ∧
  (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat → t (e i) = ((l : F) - 2*(i : F)) • e i)
def DividedMatrices (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ r i : ℕ, i ≤ l.toNat →
    dp a r (eNat d v i) =
      (if r ≤ i then (Nat.choose (l.toNat-i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i-r) else 0) ∧
    dp d r (eNat d v i) =
      (if i+r ≤ l.toNat then (Nat.choose (i+r) r : ℂ) • eNat d v (i+r) else 0)
def N1 (l : ℤ) (a d t : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  0 < l+1 ∧ Fintype.card (I l) = (l+1).toNat ∧ Strings l a d t v ∧
  BasisString l d v ∧ Matrices l a d t (eNat d v) ∧ DividedMatrices l a d v
noncomputable def unit (l : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) (i j : I l) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def BasisSpec (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, b i = eNat d v i.val
def LocalRingSpec (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ R p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / b) ∧
  (∀ b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → IsUnit (b : R p))
def SmallUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → ¬ p ∣ r.factorial ∧ IsUnit (r.factorial : R p)) ∧
  (∀ j : I l, IsUnit (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : R p))
def IotaSpec (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  (∀ (r : R p) (m : M), f (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ (r : R p) (z : MR p M), f (r • z) = (((r : ℚ) : ℂ)) • f z)
def LocalBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective f ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range f) = ⊤
def Preserved (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ m ∈ M, dp a r m ∈ M ∧ dp d r m ∈ M) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ z : MR p M, dp a r (f z) ∈ Set.range f ∧ dp d r (f z) ∈ Set.range f)
def UnitIdentities (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat = unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) = unit l b i (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
    (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val) = (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ) • unit l b (Fin.last l.toNat) j
def AllUnits (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V)
    (a d : Module.End ℂ V) (b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I l,
    unit l b i j = ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℂ)⁻¹) •
      (dp a (l.toNat-i.val) * (dp d l.toNat * dp a l.toNat) * dp d (l.toNat-j.val)) ∧
    (∀ z : MR p M, unit l b i j (f z) ∈ Set.range f)

abbrev LZ (x y h : L) := Submodule.span ℤ ({x,y,h} : Set L)
def Lift (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) (g : Module.End K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  ∃ fm : Module.End ℤ M, (∀ m : M, (fm m : V) = f (m : V)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), g (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (fm m))
structure Action (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) where
  onM : LZ x y h →ₗ[ℤ] Module.End ℤ M
  onM_spec : ∀ s : LZ x y h, ∀ m : M, (onM s m : V) = rho (s : L) (m : V)
  bracket_mem : ∀ s t : LZ x y h, ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ ∈ LZ x y h
  red : K ⊗[ℤ] LZ x y h →ₗ[K] Module.End K (VK K M)
  red_spec : ∀ (c d : K) (s : LZ x y h) (m : M),
    red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = (c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] onM s m
  red_lie : ∀ s t u : LZ x y h, (u : L) = ⁅(s : L),(t : L)⁆ → ∀ c d : K,
    red ((c*d) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) = red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) * red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) - red (d ⊗ₜ[ℤ] t) * red (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s)
  a : Module.End K (VK K M)
  d : Module.End K (VK K M)
  t : Module.End K (VK K M)
  a_spec : Lift K M (rho x) a
  d_spec : Lift K M (rho y) d
  t_spec : Lift K M (rho h) t
  gen_spec : ∀ (s : LZ x y h),
    ((s : L) = x → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = a) ∧
    ((s : L) = y → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = d) ∧
    ((s : L) = h → red (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] s) = t)
def N2 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  LocalRingSpec p ∧ SmallUnits p l ∧ Nonempty (Action K M rho x y h) ∧
  ∃ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f ∧ LocalBasis p l M f ∧
    Preserved p M f (rho x) (rho y) ∧
    (∀ b : Module.Basis (I l) ℂ V, BasisSpec l (rho y) v b →
      UnitIdentities l (rho x) (rho y) b ∧ AllUnits p l M f (rho x) (rho y) b)
def CoeffSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (i : I l) (c : ℂ), (cv p).symm c ∈ J ↔ c • eNat d v i.val ∈ Set.range f) ∧
  J.FG ∧ J ≠ ⊥ ∧
  ∃ D : (I l → J) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M, ∀ g : I l → J, f (D g) = ∑ i, cv p (g i : C p) • eNat d v i.val
def MuSpec (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J), mu (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * cv p (c : C p)
def RationalEmbedding (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) ∧
  ∃ mu : ℚ ⊗[R p] J →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ, MuSpec p J mu ∧ Function.Injective mu ∧
    LinearMap.range mu = Submodule.span ℚ ((cv p) '' (J : Set (C p)))
def ScaledBasis (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M), ∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val
def CyclicSpec (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b}) ∧
  (∀ b : ℂ, (cv p).symm b ∈ J → b ≠ 0 → J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b} → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b)
def N3 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V, IotaSpec p M f →
    ∃ J : Submodule (R p) (C p), CoeffSpec p l d v M f J ∧ RationalEmbedding p J ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J) = 1 ∧ CyclicSpec p l d v M f J
def RationalMultiples (p : ℕ) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : ℂ, (cv p).symm a ∈ J → a ≠ 0 → ∀ c : ℂ, (cv p).symm c ∈ J → ∃ q : ℚ, c = (q : ℂ) * a
def PDecomposition (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 → ∃ (nu : ℤ) (u : (R p)ˣ), q = (p : ℚ)^nu * (u.val : ℚ)
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
  ∃ A : Action K M rho x y h, ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
    Stable W A.a → Stable W A.d → Stable W A.t → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤

structure Residue (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] where
  phi : R p →+* K
  psi : R p →+* ZMod p
  kappa : ZMod p →+* K
  phi_fraction : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / b → phi r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹
  psi_fraction : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / b → psi r = (a : ZMod p) * (b : ZMod p)⁻¹
  kappa_int : ∀ a : ℤ, kappa (a : ZMod p) = (a : K)
  compatible : phi = kappa.comp psi
  psi_surjective : Function.Surjective psi
  psi_kernel : RingHom.ker psi = Ideal.span {(p : R p)}
  eps : (R p) ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : R p)} ≃+* ZMod p
  eps_spec : ∀ r : R p, eps (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(p : R p)}) r) = psi r
  units_nonzero : ∀ u : (R p)ˣ, phi u.val ≠ 0
def GammaPure (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra (R p) K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (phi : R p →+* K) (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M) : Prop :=
  (∀ (c : K) (m : M), G (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
  (∀ (c : K) (r : R p) (m : M), G.symm (c ⊗ₜ[R p] (r ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) = (phi r*c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
def DeltaPure (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra (R p) K] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    (M : Submodule ℤ V) (D : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), D (c ⊗ₜ[R p] z) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p z) ∧
  (∀ (c : K) (z : MR p M), D.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p z) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] z)
def Bridge (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  letI := Q.kappa.toAlgebra
  ∃ (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
    (D : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)),
    GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧ DeltaPure p K M D ∧
    (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (z : VK K M),
      G (F.baseChange K z) = ((F.baseChange (R p)).baseChange K) (G z)) ∧
    (∀ F : Module.End (R p) (MR p M),
      ∃ Fb : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (MR p M) p),
        (∀ z : MR p M, Fb (ModN.mkQ p z) = ModN.mkQ p (F z)) ∧
        (∀ z : K ⊗[R p] MR p M, D (F.baseChange K z) = Fb.baseChange K (D z)))
noncomputable def extend {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A] (l : ℤ)
    (b : Module.Basis (I l) F A) (k : ℕ) : A :=
  if hk : k < l.toNat+1 then b ⟨k,hk⟩ else 0
def polynomial {F A : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (l : ℤ) (a d : Module.End F A) (i j : I l) : Module.End F A :=
  (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : F)⁻¹ •
    (((((l.toNat-i.val).factorial : F)⁻¹) • a^(l.toNat-i.val)) *
    (((l.toNat.factorial : F)⁻¹) • d^l.toNat) *
    (((l.toNat.factorial : F)⁻¹) • a^l.toNat) *
    (((((l.toNat-j.val).factorial : F)⁻¹) • d^(l.toNat-j.val))))
def ReducedBasisSpec (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (A : Action K M rho x y h)
    (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)) : Prop :=
  Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat+1 ∧
  Matrices l A.a A.d A.t (extend l beta) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat →
    (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
    Lift K M (dp (rho x) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.a^r) ∧
    Lift K M (dp (rho y) r) (((r.factorial : K)⁻¹) • A.d^r)) ∧
  (∀ i j : I l, (Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ k : I l, polynomial l A.a A.d i j (beta k) = if k = j then beta i else 0)
def Transfer (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (d : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (b : ℂ), IotaSpec p M f → ScaledBasis p l d v M f b →
    ∃ (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
      (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
      GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧
      (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat d v i.val) ∧
      (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) ∧
      Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat+1
def ReducedPackage (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) (Q : Residue p K) : Prop :=
  letI := Q.phi.toAlgebra
  ∀ A : Action K M rho x y h,
    ∃ (f : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] V) (J : Submodule (R p) (C p)) (b : ℂ)
      (G : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R p] MR p M)
      (B : Module.Basis (I l) (R p) (MR p M)) (beta : Module.Basis (I l) K (VK K M)),
      IotaSpec p M f ∧ Function.Injective f ∧ CoeffSpec p l (rho y) v M f J ∧
      (cv p).symm b ∈ J ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J = Submodule.span (R p) {(cv p).symm b} ∧
      GammaPure p K M Q.phi G ∧
      (∀ i, f (B i) = b • eNat (rho y) v i.val) ∧
      (∀ i, beta i = G.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R p] B i)) ∧
      ReducedBasisSpec l K M rho x y h A beta
def N4 (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (rho : L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : L) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ Q : Residue p K, Bridge p K M Q ∧ ReducedPackage p l K M rho x y h v Q
end LR
